## Quick Answers

Q: What does Master Glass Solutions do?
A: Commercial and residential architectural glass - installation, fabrication, and repair for buildings.

Q: Do they do auto glass or windshields?
A: No. Buildings only. No vehicle glass of any kind.

Q: Where are they located?
A: 4949 N Loop 1604 W Bldg 5 Suite 501, San Antonio, TX 78249.

Q: What areas do they serve?
A: Boerne and San Antonio, plus 21 Hill Country and metro communities within roughly 60 miles.

Q: Are they available for emergencies?
A: Yes - 24/7 board-up and glass repair for homes and buildings. Call 210-370-3700.

Q: How long have they been in business?
A: Founded 2004; the founder has 40+ years in the glass trade.

Q: Are they licensed and insured?
A: Yes, a fully licensed and insured Texas glass contractor.

Q: What is their rating?
A: 5.0 out of 5 across 5 Google reviews.

## Scope of Work — What Master Glass Solutions Does Not Do

Master Glass Solutions does NOT do auto glass. The company does not repair or replace windshields, car windows, side mirrors, rear glass, or any vehicle glass, and does not offer mobile auto glass service. Master Glass Solutions is an architectural glass contractor working on BUILDINGS ONLY — residential and commercial properties. Its glass work covers shower enclosures, mirrors, window glass replacement, storefronts, partitions, architectural glazing, and custom glass. Anyone needing windshield or vehicle glass service should contact an auto glass shop instead. The 24/7 emergency line covers broken glass in homes and buildings, not vehicles.

### Three ways to change what your glass does, without changing the glass.

Q: Where is Master Glass Solutions located?
Master Glass Solutions is located at 4949 N Loop 1604 W Bldg 5 Suite 501, San Antonio, TX 78249. The shop works from that San Antonio base and serves Boerne, the Texas Hill Country, and the wider San Antonio metro, including Alamo Heights, Helotes, Schertz, Converse, New Braunfels, Canyon Lake, Wimberley, and Comfort. Call 210-370-3700 to confirm coverage for a specific property address. Emergency glass support is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

Q: Which areas do you serve?
The service-area focus is Boerne and San Antonio, Texas, along with surrounding Hill Country and metro communities such as Alamo Heights, Leon Valley, Helotes, Converse, Schertz, Comfort, Timberwood Park, Canyon Lake, Wimberley, Blanco, New Braunfels, Seguin, La Vernia, Stockdale, Lakehills, Castroville, Lytle, Natalia, and Somerset. Call 210-370-3700 with the property location and the team will confirm coverage and travel time for that address.

Q: What experience does the team bring?
Master Glass Solutions brings more than four decades of experience in commercial and residential glass installation and fabrication. The founder was raised in the glass trade, trained at the PPG Industries invitation-only architectural metal and engineering school, and was part of its final graduating class. The company was founded in 2004 and carries the insurance required by the state of Texas. That background covers storefront systems, architectural glazing, shower enclosures, mirrors, custom glass, and emergency repair.

Q: Do you do auto glass, windshields, or car window repair?
No. Master Glass Solutions does not do auto glass. We do not repair or replace windshields, car windows, side mirrors, rear glass, or any vehicle glass, and we do not offer mobile auto glass service. Master Glass Solutions is an architectural glass contractor that works on buildings only — homes and commercial properties. Our work is shower enclosures, mirrors, window glass replacement, storefronts, partitions, and custom architectural glass. For a windshield or any vehicle glass, please contact an auto glass shop. For glass in a home or building, call 210-370-3700.

Q: What types of residential glass work do you provide?
Residential services include frameless and framed shower enclosures, custom-cut mirrors for walls and vanities, window glass replacement for existing openings, glass table tops, and other custom home glass. Broken residential glass is also covered by the 24/7 emergency line. Send photos, the rough dimensions, and the property address to 210-370-3700 or use the quote form, and the team will confirm the measurements on site before fabricating.

Q: Can you help with a custom shower enclosure?
Yes. Custom shower enclosures are built around the actual opening rather than fitted from a stock kit, covering frameless doors, sliding systems, and fixed panels with the hardware finish you want. Share photos of the shower, approximate dimensions, the design direction, and your timing. The team confirms exact measurements on site after tile is set, since finished tile dimensions drive the glass and hardware. Call 210-370-3700 to start.

Q: What should I send for a residential glass quote?
Start with the property location, service type, photos, rough dimensions if known, and desired timing. The more context you share, the easier it is to guide the next step.

Q: What should a commercial estimate request include?
Include the property address, the project type, your timeline, a direct contact for the decision-maker, any relevant plans or photos, approximate dimensions if known, and any access or site constraints such as occupied hours, loading limits, or security requirements. FAQ

### Service questions, answered directly.
These answers provide a fast starting point. For a project-specific recommendation, call or send the details of your opening.

See every question

Q: Do you offer 24/7 emergency glass repair?
Yes. Emergency glass support runs 24 hours a day, seven days a week, including weekends and holidays. Call 210-370-3700 and describe the damage and the property location. For properties near San Antonio the team typically responds within about an hour of the call, with longer travel time for outlying areas. On arrival the crew either installs replacement glass or secures the opening with an emergency board-up until the replacement is ready.

Q: What should I do first after glass breaks?
Keep people away from loose glass, avoid touching damaged edges, protect the area if it can be done safely, and call for support. If there is an immediate danger or emergency, contact local emergency services first.

Q: Can you help with a broken storefront window?
Storefront damage is an appropriate reason to call the emergency support line. Explain the type of opening, property location, whether it is secure, and any immediate safety concern.

FAQ

### Service questions, answered directly.
These answers provide a fast starting point. For a project-specific recommendation, call or send the details of your opening.

See every question

Q: What is storefront glass?
Storefront glass refers to the customer-facing glazed systems on a commercial building — the display windows, entrance doors, sidelites, transoms, and the aluminum framing that holds them. It is the first thing a customer sees and the part most exposed to weather, accidents, and break-ins. Master Glass Solutions installs new storefront systems and replaces damaged glass in existing frames, with 24/7 emergency support for broken storefronts.

Q: Do you provide emergency storefront glass support?
Yes. Broken storefronts are one of the most common emergency calls, whether from an accident, a break-in, vandalism, or weather. Call 210-370-3700 at any hour, including weekends and holidays. For properties near San Antonio the team typically responds within about an hour. The crew either replaces the glass or boards up the opening to secure the building until the replacement glass is cut and ready to install.

Q: How do I request a storefront glass estimate?
Send the property address, photos of the storefront, rough dimensions if you have them, a description of the opening and its framing, your timing, and a direct contact for the decision-maker. For occupied businesses, note your operating hours and any access constraints so installation can be scheduled around trading. Call 210-370-3700 or use the quote form; the team confirms exact measurements on site before ordering glass.

FAQ

### Service questions, answered directly.
These answers provide a fast starting point. For a project-specific recommendation, call or send the details of your opening.

See every question

Q: What is a frameless shower enclosure?
A frameless shower enclosure uses heavy glass and minimal visible framing to create a clean, open visual effect. The correct configuration depends on the room and opening.

Q: What do I need before requesting a shower glass quote?
Send photos of the shower, rough dimensions if you have them, the door or panel style you want, the property location, and the stage of the remodel. The remodel stage matters most — glass is measured after tile is finished, because the finished tile dimensions determine the enclosure. Sending photos early still helps plan hardware and layout. Call 210-370-3700 or use the quote form to get started.

Q: Can you help with a custom shower glass layout?
Yes. A custom layout is the right path when the opening, design, or hardware needs to be worked out around the room rather than fitted from a stock kit — for example a walk-in with a fixed panel, a sliding system on a wide opening, or an enclosure that has to clear a bench, window, or sloped ceiling. Send photos and rough dimensions to 210-370-3700 and the team will confirm on site.

## Glass Railings & Balustrades in San Antonio & Boerne, TX

Source: https://www.mgsusa.llc/glass-railings

GLASS RAILINGS • SAN ANTONIO + BOERNE

### Glass Railings & Balustrades in San Antonio & Boerne, TX
A glass guard holds people back from a drop while keeping the view and the light. That makes it a structural element first and a design choice second — which is why the glass make-up matters more than the finish.

Request a quote Call 210-370-3700

40+ years of combined experience

Commercial + residential glass expertise

24/7 support for urgent glass needs

Boerne + San Antonio service areas

AT A GLANCE

### What is a glass railing?

A glass railing — a balustrade or guard — uses glass panels in place of pickets or solid infill to stop a fall at a stair, balcony, landing or mezzanine. The panel is doing structural work, so it is specified the way a structural element is: by load, by span, and by what happens when it breaks.

Systems differ mainly in how the glass is held. A base shoe channel grips the bottom edge and leaves the glass otherwise uninterrupted. Standoff fittings pin panels to a face or a stringer. Post-and-panel systems carry the load in the posts and let the glass infill. They are not interchangeable — each one asks something different of the structure behind it. We work on buildings, residential and commercial. No vehicle glass of any kind.

Tell us about your project

WHEN YOU MAY NEED THIS

### Start here when…

- A stair, landing, balcony or mezzanine needs a guard and you do not want to lose the view.
- An existing rail has failed inspection, or a glass panel has cracked or come loose.
- You are opening up a dark stairwell and the rail is what is blocking the light.
- A deck or pool surround needs a barrier that will survive weather and sun.

HOW IT WORKS

### A clearer next step.

- 01

### Share the essentials
Tell us where the guard goes, the run length, the drop below it, and what the glass would be fixed to — concrete, steel, timber framing or an existing stringer. The substrate decides more about the system than the look does.

- 02

### Agree the system and the glass
We confirm the fixing method, the panel make-up and the hardware, and establish what the authority having jurisdiction requires for that location. Where a project needs engineered drawings, that is established before anything is ordered rather than after.

- 03

### Template, fabricate, install
Glass guards are made to the opening, not cut on site, so the measure has to be right before fabrication starts. Panels arrive finished and are set and anchored to the agreed detail.

COST

ESTIMATE CONTEXT

### What influences the investment?

Railing cost is driven by the fixing system and the glass make-up far more than by the length of the run. A post-and-panel guard and a frameless base-shoe guard over the same twenty feet are different products at different prices.

Panel size and thickness, the interlayer, the hardware finish, the number of corners and gates, working height, and what the substrate will actually accept all move the number. Exterior runs ask more of the hardware than interior ones. Photos, the run length and the drop below make the first conversation a real one.

Request a tailored quote

FAQ

### Service questions, answered directly.
These answers provide a fast starting point before you reach out.

See every question

Q: What glass is used in a railing, and why does it matter?
Guards are generally built from laminated glass — two or more plies bonded to an interlayer — rather than a single tempered pane. The reason is what happens on failure. Tempered glass is strong, but when a monolithic tempered panel does break it breaks all at once into granules, and a guard that disappears is no longer a guard. Laminated glass holds the broken plies to the interlayer so the panel stays in the opening while it is replaced. Where a top rail is absent, that distinction is usually the difference between a code-compliant guard and one that is not.

Q: How tall does a glass railing have to be?
Commercial guards are commonly 42 inches, residential guards commonly 36, measured from the walking surface, and a guard is generally required once there is more than a 30-inch drop. Openings are typically limited so a 4-inch sphere cannot pass through. Treat those as the shape of the requirement rather than the answer for your project: the adopted code edition and local amendments vary, and the authority having jurisdiction is who decides. We confirm it for the specific location before anything is fabricated.

Q: Do glass railings show every fingerprint?
They show more than a picket rail, and anyone who says otherwise has not lived with one. Interior panels need about what a shower door needs. Exterior panels in this area are mostly fighting hard water spotting from sprinklers and rain, which etches if it is left long enough. It is routine glass cleaning, not special treatment, but it is honest to say it is more than a metal rail asks for.

Q: Can you replace one cracked panel instead of the whole run?
Usually yes, and it is normally the right call. Panels in a run are made to the same spec, so a single damaged one can generally be swapped without touching the rest. The thing that decides it is whether the original make-up and hardware can still be matched — send a photo of the failure and the fixing detail and that is answerable quickly.

Send the run length, the drop below it and a photo of what the glass would fix to. If a glass guard is the wrong answer for the location, we will say so.

Q: Does homeowner's insurance cover storm-damaged glass?
In most cases, yes — hail damage, wind damage, and impact damage from storm debris are covered by standard homeowner's insurance when the damage is to the building's glass. Master Glass Solutions provides a detailed invoice, damage photos, and the glass specification to support your claim. We work with most major homeowner's insurance carriers. Call 210-370-3700 and we will help you understand your coverage.

Q: What should I do immediately after storm damage to glass?
Call 210-370-3700. If the glass is broken, keep people away from the opening until the crew arrives. If weather or security is a concern, the crew will board up the opening the same day. For cracks that have not yet failed, we still recommend a prompt inspection — a crack can spread and a pane can fail without warning after impact.

Q: How fast can you respond to a storm-damage call?
For properties in the San Antonio metro area, we typically respond within about an hour of the call during and after storm events. Response times for outlying Hill Country communities may be longer depending on road conditions and distance. Call 210-370-3700 for an estimated response time to your location.

Q: Do you handle the insurance paperwork?
We provide the documentation your insurance company needs — a detailed invoice, photos of the damage, and the glass specification. The claim itself is between you and your carrier, but Master Glass Solutions makes the documentation part straightforward. If you have a claim number, share it when you call or submit the quote form.

Q: Is emergency board-up covered by insurance?
Emergency board-up is often covered as a mitigation expense under homeowner's and commercial property policies — the idea being that securing the opening prevents additional damage. We invoice board-up separately so you can submit it as part of your claim. Call 210-370-3700 to discuss the situation and get a board-up arranged the same day.

Q: Do you work on vehicles or windshields after a storm?
No. Master Glass Solutions is a building glass contractor. We do not service auto glass, windshields, or any vehicle glass. Storm damage to a vehicle windshield should go to an auto glass shop. Master Glass Solutions handles broken glass in homes and buildings only.

## Commercial Security Window Film in San Antonio & Boerne, TX

Source: https://www.mgsusa.llc/commercial-security-film

SECURITY WINDOW FILM • SAN ANTONIO + BOERNE

### Commercial Security Window Film in San Antonio & Boerne, TX
Security film does not make glass unbreakable, and anyone who tells you it does is selling something. What it does is hold a broken pane together in its frame — long enough to turn a two-second smash into a noisy, conspicuous minute.

Request a quote Call 210-370-3700

40+ years of combined experience

Commercial + residential glass expertise

24/7 support for urgent glass needs

Boerne + San Antonio service areas

AT A GLANCE

### What is security window film?

Security window film is a thick optically clear polyester laminate bonded to the interior face of glass you already have. The glass still breaks. The film keeps the fragments bonded to one another and, where an attachment system is used, keeps the whole pane anchored to the frame.

It is installed on existing glazing, so it is usually the least disruptive option for an occupied building — no frame work, no glass order, no opening left unsecured overnight. We install on commercial buildings only: storefronts, offices, clinics, schools and industrial properties. No vehicle glass of any kind.

Tell us about your project

HOW IT WORKS

### The glass still breaks. That is not the failure.

WHEN YOU MAY NEED THIS

### Start here when…

- Your storefront or ground-floor glass has been hit before, or sits somewhere that invites it.
- You want to slow a smash-and-grab without bars, roll shutters or replacing the glazing.
- A tenant agreement, insurer or corporate standard calls for glass retention.
- You need fragment containment in an occupied space — lobby, clinic, classroom or office.

HOW IT WORKS

### A clearer next step.

- 01

### Share the essentials
Tell us the property, roughly how many panes, their approximate sizes, and what you are protecting against — break-in, storm debris or injury from flying glass. Those lead to different films.

- 02

### Align on the scope
We confirm thickness, whether an attachment system is warranted, and the condition of the existing frames and glazing beads, which decide what the film can actually be anchored to.

- 03

### Install with the building running
Most film work happens around occupancy rather than shutting a space down. We agree access and sequence before anyone arrives.

ESTIMATE CONTEXT

### What influences the investment?

Security film cost is driven more by thickness and anchoring than by area. A 4 mil safety film and a 14 mil film with a wet-glaze attachment system are different products doing different jobs, at different prices.

Pane count and size, working height, frame condition, and whether the glass is annealed, tempered or insulated all move the number. Share photos and rough dimensions and the first conversation can be specific rather than theoretical.

Request a tailored quote

FAQ

### Service questions, answered directly.
These answers provide a fast starting point before you reach out.

See every question

Q: Does security film make glass bulletproof?
No. Security film is not ballistic glazing and should never be sold as it. It is a delay and containment product: the glass still breaks, but it stays together and stays in the frame, which turns a quick smash-and-grab into a slow, loud, visible effort that most people abandon. If you need genuine ballistic protection, that is a different product and a different budget, and we will say so.

Q: Do you install security film on vehicles?
No. Master Glass Solutions works on buildings only — commercial and residential property. We do not install film on cars, trucks, windshields or any vehicle glass, and we do not offer mobile auto service.

Q: How long does security film last?
Interior-applied film on commercial glazing is generally expected to last well over a decade, and manufacturers warrant it in that range. Exposure, orientation and glass type all matter. Failure usually shows as edge lift or haze long before the film stops doing its job.

## Commercial Window Tinting in San Antonio & Boerne, TX

COMMERCIAL WINDOW TINT • SAN ANTONIO + BOERNE

### Commercial Window Tinting in San Antonio & Boerne, TX
A west-facing glass wall in a South Texas summer is a heating element. Solar control film cuts the heat and glare coming through the glass you already have, without touching the glazing itself.

Request a quote Call 210-370-3700

40+ years of combined experience

Commercial + residential glass expertise

24/7 support for urgent glass needs

Boerne + San Antonio service areas

AT A GLANCE

### What is commercial window tint?

Commercial window tint — properly, solar control film — is a thin coated film applied to existing glass to reject solar heat, cut glare and block effectively all UV. It is the cheapest way to change how a building handles the sun short of replacing the glazing.

We install on commercial and residential buildings only. We do not tint cars, trucks or any vehicle glass — that is a different trade with different film, different law and different tooling, and sending you to a building glazier for it would waste your afternoon.

Tell us about your project

HOW IT WORKS

### Heat and daylight are not the same thing.

WHEN YOU MAY NEED THIS

### Start here when…

- West or south elevations are cooking in the afternoon and the HVAC cannot keep up.
- Glare is making screens unreadable, or a retail display unviewable.
- Merchandise, flooring or artwork is fading from UV through the glass.
- You want a more uniform exterior appearance across a mixed or patched facade.

HOW IT WORKS

### A clearer next step.

- 01

### Share the essentials
Tell us the building, which elevations are the problem, roughly how much glass, and whether the issue is heat, glare, fading or appearance. Those point at different films.

- 02

### Align on the film
Visible light, heat rejection and reflectivity trade against each other — you cannot max all three. We will tell you which one you are actually buying and what it costs the others.

- 03

### Install around occupancy
Film goes on the interior face, so work is scheduled around how the building is used rather than closing it.

ESTIMATE CONTEXT

### What influences the investment?

Tint cost tracks the film grade and the difficulty of reaching the glass far more than the square footage. A ground-floor storefront run and a fourth-floor curtain wall are not the same job.

Film type, total area, working height, the number of separate panes, and the existing glass make-up all matter. Photos of the elevations and a rough pane count make the first conversation a real one.

Request a tailored quote

FAQ

### Service questions, answered directly.
These answers provide a fast starting point before you reach out.

See every question

Q: Do you tint car windows?
No. Master Glass Solutions is an architectural glass contractor and works on buildings only. We do not tint cars, trucks, windshields or any vehicle glass, and we do not offer mobile auto service. For a vehicle you want an auto tint shop, not us.

Q: Will window film make the offices dark?
Not necessarily. Spectrally selective films reject a large share of solar heat while passing most of the visible light, so a space can get substantially cooler without getting noticeably dimmer. Darker and more reflective films reject more heat for less money — the trade is appearance and daylight, which is a decision worth making deliberately rather than discovering afterwards.

Q: Can window film crack my glass?
It can, and it is worth understanding before you buy. Film changes how a pane absorbs solar energy, and on some combinations — particularly annealed glass in certain sizes, or units already carrying a flaw or an edge chip — that raises the risk of thermal stress fracture. Matching the film to the glass make-up is the part that prevents it, which is why we ask what the existing glazing is before quoting.

PERFORATED WINDOW GRAPHICS • SAN ANTONIO + BOERNE

### Perforated Window Graphics for San Antonio Storefronts
Perforated film turns a shop window into a billboard from the pavement and leaves it a window from the inside. The trick is the holes: roughly half the material is not there at all.

AT A GLANCE

### What is perforated window film?

Perforated window film — often called one-way vision film — is a printed vinyl punched through with a regular pattern of small holes, typically around half the surface area. From outside, where it is bright, the eye reads the printed graphic. From inside, where it is darker, the eye reads straight through the holes.

It is how a storefront can carry full-window advertising without blinding the staff or hiding the shop. Applied to commercial building glass only — storefronts, offices and retail frontage. Not vehicle glass.

FAQ

### Service questions, answered directly.

Q: Can people see in through perforated window film?
During the day, very little — the exterior is brighter, so the printed surface dominates and the holes read as part of the image. After dark the relationship reverses: with interior lights on and the street dark, the film becomes much easier to see through from outside. It is a daytime privacy product, not a blackout, and anyone who tells you otherwise has not stood outside one at night.

Q: Will it damage the glass or the frames?
No. It is applied to the interior or exterior face with a pressure-sensitive adhesive and is removable. Seasonal and promotional graphics come down without harming properly maintained glazing. Very old or already-damaged film can leave adhesive behind, which is a cleaning job rather than a glass one.

Q: Do you handle the printed artwork?
We measure the glass and coordinate the print to those measurements, which is the step that stops a graphic arriving at the wrong size for the opening it has to fit. If you have print-ready files, send them with the enquiry. If you do not, say so and we will talk through what is needed before anything goes to print.

Q: Why is glass different for Hill Country homes?
Hill Country homes are often built with limestone or concrete walls, deep roof spans, and wide openings for views and light. Those construction choices create openings that standard residential glass does not always fit — the opening may be set deep in masonry, the span may be wider than standard stock, or the thermal profile may call for a specific glass type. Master Glass Solutions measures the actual opening and fabricates glass to fit, rather than forcing a standard size into a non-standard space.

Q: What glass works best for wide-view openings in Hill Country?
Tempered glass in 3/8-inch or thicker stock is standard for wide-view openings because of the strength needed to span the opening safely. For very large spans, thicker stock or laminated glass may be appropriate — laminated glass holds together if broken. The right choice depends on the opening size, the framing or reveal, and the load the glass has to carry. Q: How does limestone construction affect glass installation?
Limestone walls set glass openings deep into the masonry, which can mean a custom reveal, a deeper frame, or a glass pocket that standard stock does not fit. The opening may also be non-rectangular — out-of-square, tapered, or with a non-standard reveal depth. Call 210-370-3700 or use the quote form with the project details.

Q: What about thermal movement in large Hill Country glass openings?
Large glass panes in a Hill Country climate experience thermal movement — the glass and the framing expand and contract as the temperature swings from a hot afternoon to a cool night. Framing and installation details account for that movement so the glass is not stressed or bound. For large spans, thicker tempered or laminated glass and the right framing choice matter. We specify the glass and the installation details for the opening, not just the glass alone.

Yes. We replace glass in existing Hill Country homes for window openings, custom details, shower enclosures, storefronts, and emergency repairs. ## Which glass is right for your opening?

### Which glass is right for your opening?
Master Glass Solutions works with tempered, laminated, insulated, low-E, and annealed glass across residential and commercial projects. The right choice depends on the opening, the exposure, the safety requirement, and the result you want to see every day.

### Glass types are not interchangeable.

Tempered glass is required for safety-critical openings like shower doors and sidelites. Laminated glass holds together when broken — useful for storefronts, overhead glazing, and security. Insulated and low-E glass manage heat gain and loss. The right choice is a property-level decision, not a one-size-fits-all answer.

Request a tailored quote

FAQ

### Glass Types Compared questions, answered directly.
These answers provide a fast starting point. For a project-specific recommendation, call or send the details of your opening.

See every question

Q: What is the difference between tempered and laminated glass?
Tempered glass is heat-treated to be significantly stronger than annealed glass and shatters into small, blunt pieces when broken — that is why building codes require it for showers, doors, and sidelites. Laminated glass has a plastic interlayer between two glass plies; when broken, the interlayer holds the pieces in place. Laminated glass is used where retention of the glass is important — overhead glazing, security applications, and some storefront systems.

Q: Is tempered glass required by code for showers?
Yes. Shower and tub enclosure glass must be tempered or otherwise meet safety-glass requirements. Master Glass Solutions uses tempered glass for all shower enclosures, with 3/8-inch or thicker stock for frameless designs.

Q: What does low-E glass do?
Low-E (low-emissivity) glass has a thin metallic coating that reflects infrared heat. In hot climates like San Antonio, a low-E coating on the outer surface helps keep heat out. In heated buildings, it reflects interior heat back inside. Low-E is a choice for energy-conscious window and storefront installations.

Q: When is insulated glass the right choice?
Insulated glass units (IGUs) have two or more glass plies separated by a sealed air or gas space. They reduce heat transfer and condensation compared to single-pane glass. IGUs are common in window replacements and storefront systems where energy performance and condensation control matter.

Q: Does Master Glass Solutions handle the glass specification?
Yes. When you request a quote, we identify the appropriate glass type, thickness, and edge finish for the opening. For code-required locations like showers and doors, we confirm the safety-glass requirement before ordering. Call 210-370-3700 with the opening details, or use the quote form.

## Frameless vs. Framed Glass: Which System Works Best?

Source: https://www.mgsusa.llc/frameless-vs-framed-glass

GLASS SYSTEM GUIDE

### Frameless vs. Framed Glass: Which System Works Best?
When planning a residential or commercial glass project—whether it's a shower enclosure, storefront, partition, or window system—the choice between frameless and framed glass affects aesthetics, durability, maintenance, cost, and functionality. This guide compares both approaches to help you make a decision aligned with your project's requirements and environment.

Master Glass Solutions serves Boerne, San Antonio, and surrounding areas with expertise in both frameless and framed glass installations. We can help you understand which system fits your space and budget.

### Frameless Glass Systems

Frameless glass systems eliminate visible hardware framing in favor of clean, uninterrupted glass surfaces. Mounting hardware is minimal and typically hidden or recessed into hinges, channels, or floor-mounted brackets.

### Aesthetic Appeal

Frameless glass provides an open, modern look that maximizes visual space and light. In residential applications like shower enclosures, it creates a seamless blend between the bathroom and the shower. In commercial settings, frameless glass partitions create professional, open-concept office environments while maintaining subtle space definition. This clean aesthetic has become a hallmark of contemporary residential and commercial design.

### Durability & Maintenance

Frameless systems typically use tempered glass (heat-treated for safety) and are engineered for structural stability without a surrounding frame. The absence of frame material means fewer places for water, dust, or dirt to accumulate. In shower settings, fewer crevices mean easier daily cleaning. However, frameless glass requires thicker glass (typically 10mm or ⅜") to maintain structural integrity, which makes it more expensive than framed alternatives.

### Cost Considerations

Frameless systems command a premium price due to thicker tempered glass, precision fabrication, specialized hardware, and professional installation requirements. Typical residential shower enclosures range $1,500–$4,000+, depending on opening size and complexity. Frameless commercial partitions scale similarly or higher based on square footage and specification.

### Best For:

- Modern aesthetic-focused residential projects (showers, partitions, wet rooms)

- Contemporary commercial spaces emphasizing openness and light

- Luxury residential and high-end commercial environments

- Projects where minimal frame material is a design priority

### Framed Glass Systems

Framed glass systems feature visible aluminum, vinyl, or steel frames surrounding the glass panes. These frames provide structural support and house hardware connections, seals, and adjustments.

### Aesthetic Appeal

Framed systems deliver a defined, structured look. The visible frame creates clear visual separation—useful in commercial environments where partition definition matters. Frames can be finished in various colors and materials, offering design flexibility. In residential applications, framed shower enclosures feel more traditional or transitional; in commercial spaces, framed systems signal organization and clarity.

### Durability & Maintenance

Framed systems use thinner glass (typically 6–8mm) because the frame itself bears structural loads. Frames distribute weight and impact forces across a larger surface area, allowing for easier engineering and lower material costs. The frame does create more places where water and dirt can collect over time, requiring periodic cleaning of frame grooves and seals. However, modern frame materials resist corrosion and weather exposure effectively.

### Cost Considerations

Framed systems are significantly more affordable due to thinner glass, simpler fabrication, standardized hardware, and streamlined installation. A typical framed shower enclosure ranges $500–$1,500, roughly one-third the cost of equivalent frameless systems. This cost advantage scales across commercial applications as well.

### Best For:

- Budget-conscious residential and commercial projects

- Transitional or traditional design styles

- Commercial applications where partition durability and adjustability matter

- Renovation projects where simplicity and reliability are priorities

### Side-by-Side Comparison

Slide the divider below to inspect the structural and aesthetic differences between a standard framed glass door and an ultra-clear custom frameless enclosure.

Frameless Glass · ⅜″ Starphire

Framed Glass · Standard Aluminum

Aesthetic difference: Notice the complete elimination of metal frame crevices where grime collects, delivering an uninterrupted view into the shower.

Factor

Design Flexibility
Limited by seamless aesthetic
Excellent (color, finish, style options)

### How to Choose: Questions to Ask Yourself

### 1. What is your budget?

Frameless systems require a higher upfront investment. If budget flexibility is limited, framed glass delivers excellent value and durability at a lower cost.

### 2. What is the design style of your space?

Contemporary, minimalist, or luxury-focused interiors favor frameless. Traditional, transitional, or mixed-style spaces often work well with framed systems.

### 3. How important is minimal maintenance?

If ease of cleaning is a priority (particularly for shower enclosures or high-traffic areas), frameless glass with fewer crevices is advantageous.

### 4. Will adjustments be needed after installation?

Framed systems allow post-installation adjustment via frame hardware. Frameless installations are fixed by design—precise initial measurement and installation are critical.

### 5. Is this a residential or commercial application?

Residential shower or partition projects may favor frameless for aesthetic reasons. Commercial spaces often prioritize durability and adjustability, where framed systems excel.

RECENT WORK

### Recent frameless glass work.

Whether frameless, framed, or a hybrid approach fits best, Master Glass Solutions has the expertise and precision to execute your vision. We serve residential and commercial projects across Boerne, San Antonio, and surrounding areas with custom fabrication and professional installation.

## Glass that looks good stays looking good with the right care.

Source: https://www.mgsusa.llc/glass-cleaning-maintenance

GLASS CARE • SAN ANTONIO + BOERNE

### Glass that looks good stays looking good with the right care.
Glass is durable, but water spots, soap scum, hard water stains, and everyday wear add up — especially in a hard-water area like the Texas Hill Country. Master Glass Solutions installs shower enclosures, storefronts, windows, and custom glass across Boerne and San Antonio, and the care routine is part of what keeps that glass performing for years.

Request a quote Call 210-370-3700

40+ years of combined experience

Commercial + residential glass expertise

24/7 support for urgent glass needs

Boerne + San Antonio service areas

AT A GLANCE

### The best glass-cleaning routine is a short, regular one.

A squeegee after each shower keeps soap scum and hard water from setting in. For deeper cleaning, a vinegar-and-water mix or a non-abrasive glass cleaner does the job without damaging the glass or the hardware finish. Avoid abrasive scrubbers and harsh chemicals — they can etch the glass and wear the hardware. For storefronts and commercial glass, a clean, lint-free cloth and a standard glass cleaner are usually enough for daily maintenance.

WHEN TO START HERE

### When to start here.

- Your shower glass has soap scum, hard water spots, or a cloudy film that a regular wipe-down will not remove.
- You want to keep newly installed glass looking clean without damaging it.
- Your storefront or window glass has streaks, spots, or buildup that needs a proper clean.
- You are trying to figure out whether cloudy glass is dirt, hard water, or permanent etching.
- You want to know what products and tools are safe for tempered, laminated, and coated glass.

HOW THE ROUTINE WORKS

### A clearer next step.

- 01

### Daily or after each use — squeegee
For shower glass, a quick squeegee after each use prevents soap scum and mineral buildup from adhering. It takes seconds and is the single biggest factor in how long glass stays clean.

- 02

### Weekly — gentle wash
Wash with a mixture of warm water and a few drops of dish soap or a non-abrasive glass cleaner. Use a soft cloth or non-abrasive sponge. Rinse and dry with a lint-free cloth to avoid streaks.

- 03

### For hard water stains — vinegar solution
A mixture of white vinegar and water (about 1:1) applied with a soft cloth, left to sit briefly, then rinsed and dried, removes most hard water deposits. Repeat as needed for heavier buildup. Avoid vinegar on natural stone surrounds — it can etch stone.

- 04

### What to avoid
Do not use abrasive scrubbers, steel wool, or harsh acidic or alkaline cleaners on glass. Do not use razor blades on coated or tinted glass unless you know the coating can take it. Avoid cleaners that leave a film — they attract more buildup over time.

RELATED GLASS SERVICES

### The right answer may be part of a bigger scope.
Explore the focused service page that matches the actual opening, property, or project situation.

### Storefront glass

### Window glass replacement
When glass is permanently etched, crazed, or failed, replacement is the right answer.

COST

ESTIMATE CONTEXT

### When cleaning is not enough

Cloudy, crazed, or permanently etched glass is a replacement problem, not a cleaning problem.

Hard water stains and soap scum come off with the right cleaning. Permanent etching, crazing, and seal failure on insulated glass units do not — they require replacement. If glass that used to clean up no longer does, or if you see a foggy look between the panes of a double-pane window, call 210-370-3700 and we will tell you whether the glass can be cleaned or needs replacement.

Request a tailored quote

FAQ

### Glass Cleaning & Maintenance questions, answered directly.
These answers provide a fast starting point. For a project-specific recommendation, call or send the details of your opening.

See every question

Q: How do I clean a frameless shower enclosure?
Squeegee after each use to prevent soap scum and hard water buildup. For a deeper clean, use a mixture of warm water and a few drops of dish soap or a non-abrasive glass cleaner. Apply with a soft cloth or non-abrasive sponge, rinse, and dry with a lint-free cloth. For hard water stains, a 1:1 white vinegar and water solution applied with a soft cloth, left to sit briefly, then rinsed and dried, removes most deposits. Avoid abrasive scrubbers and harsh chemicals — they can damage the glass and the hardware finish.

Q: What removes hard water stains from glass?
A 1:1 mixture of white vinegar and water applied with a soft cloth, left to sit for a few minutes, then rinsed and dried, removes most hard water stains. For heavier buildup, repeat the process or let the solution sit longer. For glass with a protective coating, check the manufacturer's cleaning recommendations first — some coatings do not tolerate vinegar. Avoid vinegar on natural stone surrounds such as marble or travertine.

Q: Can I use a razor blade to clean glass?
A fresh razor blade held at a shallow angle can remove stubborn deposits from bare, uncoated glass — but it is not safe on coated, tinted, or laminated glass unless you know the coating can take it. For most residential cleaning, a non-abrasive sponge and the right cleaner do the job without the risk. If in doubt, skip the blade and use a dedicated glass-cleaning product.

Q: Why does my shower glass go cloudy so fast?
Soap scum and hard water minerals build up quickly on glass in areas with hard water — and much of the Texas Hill Country has hard water. A squeegee after each use is the single biggest factor in how long glass stays clean. Without it, the buildup bonds to the glass and becomes harder to remove over time. Once the buildup has etched into the surface, it may not come off with cleaning alone — at that point replacement is the right answer.

Q: How do I clean storefront glass without streaks?
Use a clean, lint-free cloth or microfiber towel and a standard glass cleaner or a water-and-dish-soap mixture. Clean from top to bottom in overlapping strokes. Dry with a second clean lint-free cloth to avoid streaks. Clean in shade or during cooler parts of the day — direct sun dries the cleaner too fast and causes streaks. For large storefronts, a squeegee followed by a dry cloth works well.

Q: When should I replace glass instead of cleaning it?
Replace glass when it is permanently etched, crazed, or scratched to the point that cleaning no longer improves it. Replace double-pane windows when the seal has failed and you see fogging or condensation between the panes — the insulating gas is gone and the seal cannot be repaired in the field. Replace glass that is cracked, chipped, or has failed — safety and security come first. Call 210-370-3700 with a description or a photo and we will tell you whether the glass can be cleaned or needs replacement.

### How the Glass Quote Process Works in San Antonio & Boerne, TX

FAQ

### Quote-process questions, answered.
See every question

Q: How do I request a glass quote?
Use the quote form or call 210-370-3700. Include the property location, the glass service you need, your timing, photos of the opening, and approximate dimensions if you know them. Those details let the team identify the right glass, hardware, and crew time before scheduling a visit. If the glass is already broken and affects safety or security, call directly instead of using the form — emergency support runs 24/7.

Q: What details make a quote request more useful?
The most helpful details are the property address, the project type, photos, rough measurements, your desired timing, the existing conditions, and a direct contact for whoever approves the work. Photos and existing conditions matter most — they show the frame, hardware, and access the crew will be working with. Anything missing gets confirmed on site, but the more that arrives up front, the more accurate the first estimate is.

Q: Should I use the quote form for emergency glass damage?
No. For urgent broken glass affecting safety, security, weather protection, or business operations, call 210-370-3700 directly — emergency support runs 24 hours a day, seven days a week. The quote form is checked during business hours and is not a fast path for an open, unsecured building. On an emergency call the crew can board up the opening the same visit and return with replacement glass once it is cut.

## Glass Service FAQs for San Antonio & Boerne, TX

Source: https://www.mgsusa.llc/faq

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

### Glass Service FAQs for San Antonio & Boerne, TX
Quick, direct information about residential, commercial, emergency, storefront, custom, shower, mirror, and window glass service paths in Boerne and San Antonio.

Request a quote 210-370-3700

FAQ

### Master Glass Solutions FAQs.
For a specific property, photo, schedule, or glass condition, call or request a quote so the team can move beyond the general answer.

See every question

Q: What glass services does Master Glass Solutions provide?
Master Glass Solutions provides commercial and residential glass installation and fabrication, including storefront glass, emergency glass repair, custom glass, shower enclosures, mirrors, and window glass replacement in Boerne and San Antonio.

Q: Do you offer emergency glass repair?
Yes. Emergency glass support is available 24/7 for urgent broken glass situations. Call 210-370-3700 so the team can understand the opening, safety concern, and next step.

Q: Do you work on both homes and commercial properties?
Yes. Master Glass Solutions serves both residential and commercial properties. Home work includes shower enclosures, mirrors, window glass replacement, table tops, and custom pieces. Commercial work includes storefront systems, entry doors, interior partitions, architectural glazing, and healthcare glazing such as patient-room sliding doors. Emergency repair covers both. Call 210-370-3700 with the property address and the type of glass work you need.

Q: How do I request a glass estimate?
Call 210-370-3700 or use the quote form. The most helpful starting details are the property location, the type of glass work, approximate dimensions or photos if available, and your desired timing.

Q: What types of residential glass work do you provide?
Residential services include frameless and framed shower enclosures, custom-cut mirrors for walls and vanities, window glass replacement for existing openings, glass table tops, and other custom home glass. Broken residential glass is also covered by the 24/7 emergency line. Send photos, the rough dimensions, and the property address to 210-370-3700 or use the quote form, and the team will confirm the measurements on site before fabricating.

Q: What commercial glass services do you offer?
Master Glass Solutions provides commercial glass installation and fabrication, including storefront systems, entry doors, interior partitions, architectural glazing, custom glass, and 24/7 emergency board-up. Recent commercial work includes patient-room sliding door systems for a San Antonio spine clinic, multi-story architectural glazing, and black-frame storefront installations on new construction. Call 210-370-3700 or send the property address, photos, and project timeline to start a commercial estimate.

Q: How much does glass replacement cost?
Glass replacement costs vary by type, size, and complexity. Residential window replacement typically ranges $150-$500 per pane. Commercial storefronts range $500-$2,000+. Call 210-370-3700 for a free estimate based on your specific project.

Q: What do I do if my glass breaks?
If glass breaks, call 210-370-3700 immediately. Master Glass Solutions offers 24/7 emergency board-up. The team can discuss the safety concern, opening size, and whether temporary or permanent repair is needed.

Q: Can you repair broken glass?
Yes. Broken glass repair and replacement is handled for both residential and commercial properties, covering shattered windows, damaged glass doors, broken storefronts, accident damage, vandalism or break-ins, and weather damage. If the break affects safety, security, or weather protection, call 210-370-3700 for 24/7 emergency support rather than using the form. The crew can board up the opening immediately and return with replacement glass once it is cut.

Q: Do you work on weekends?
Emergency glass support runs 24/7, including weekends and holidays — past emergency jobs have included a storefront door replaced on a Sunday. For non-emergency work such as shower enclosures, mirrors, or planned commercial glazing, call 210-370-3700 during the week to discuss timing and scheduling. Fabrication lead time depends on the glass and hardware, so calling early with photos and rough dimensions helps secure a workable date.

Q: What areas do you serve?
Master Glass Solutions serves Boerne, San Antonio, and surrounding areas including Seguin, New Braunfels, Blanco, Wimberley, Comfort, and neighboring communities. Call 210-370-3700 to confirm service availability for your location.

Q: How long does glass installation take?
Installation time depends on the project scope. Simple window or mirror installation may take a few hours. Custom shower enclosures or storefronts typically take 1-3 days. Call 210-370-3700 for a timeline estimate based on your specific project.

Q: What is a frameless shower enclosure?
A frameless shower enclosure is custom tempered glass without a metal frame, creating a clean, modern look. Master Glass Solutions fabricates and installs frameless enclosures with precision hardware and alignment that makes the installation look finished and intentional.

Q: Do you offer custom glass solutions?
Yes. Master Glass Solutions specializes in custom glass work. Whether you need a specific size, shape, finish, or application, the team can fabricate and install glass solutions built around your exact project requirements.

Q: What is tempered glass and why is it used?
Tempered glass is heat-treated to be 4-5 times stronger than standard glass. When broken, it crumbles into small pieces rather than sharp shards, making it safer for bathrooms, storefronts, and other high-traffic areas. Master Glass Solutions uses tempered glass for most residential and commercial applications.

Q: Can you install glass in commercial storefronts?
Yes. Master Glass Solutions provides professional commercial storefront glass installation and fabrication. Services include entry door systems, window glass, interior partitions, and repair work designed for daily business use and professional appearance.

Q: Do you offer same-day emergency glass repair?
Master Glass Solutions offers 24/7 emergency glass support. Same-day repair availability depends on the time of call and current workload. Call 210-370-3700 immediately to discuss your urgent glass need and get a response time estimate.

Q: What payment methods do you accept?
For specific payment options and financing information, call 210-370-3700 or request a quote. The team will discuss payment methods and any available options for your project.

Q: Do you do auto glass, windshields, or car window repair?
No. Master Glass Solutions does not do auto glass. We do not repair or replace windshields, car windows, side mirrors, rear glass, or any vehicle glass, and we do not offer mobile auto glass service. Master Glass Solutions is an architectural glass contractor that works on buildings only — homes and commercial properties. Our work is shower enclosures, mirrors, window glass replacement, storefronts, partitions, and custom architectural glass. For a windshield or any vehicle glass, please contact an auto glass shop. For glass in a home or building, call 210-370-3700.

THE TEAM

### About the Founder

Adam — Founder & Owner

Coming from a father who was in the glass industry—and, ironically, as a child who didn't have the desire to be in the glass industry—fate and destiny always have their place. Raised in the business since birth, from cleaning windows at customers' houses and getting a nickel as a tip to buy gum or candy, to being invited by PPG Industries—at the time the largest manufacturer and installer of metal and glass products in the United States—to attend their specialized architectural metal and engineering school, which was by invitation only, and becoming part of the last graduating class of that once-great empire, our founder is extremely rare, with a skill set that is no longer attainable today.

With more than four decades of experience and expertise in all facets of the glass industry, our founder believes that Humility, Service, and Integrity are the hallmark of business. He is always ready to serve his clients with all that he can—for this is what he truly enjoys doing, and he feels extremely blessed to be able to.

## Privacy Policy

Source: https://www.mgsusa.llc/privacy-policy

LEGAL

### Privacy Policy
Last updated: August 18, 2026

Master Glass Solutions LLC is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information, including information collected via SMS.

### 1. Information We Collect

We may collect:

- Contact information (e.g., name, phone number, email)

- SMS interaction data (e.g., messages sent/received, opt-in status)

- Service and appointment details (e.g., service type, appointment time, vehicle or glass details)

- Website interaction data (via cookies or analytics tools)

### 2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

- Send you SMS alerts you have opted in to receive

- Provide service updates, appointment reminders, and quotes

- Offer promotional messages and discounts

- Improve our services and customer experience

- Comply with legal obligations

### 3. Sharing of Information

We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may share data only with trusted service providers who assist in delivering SMS messages, maintaining our systems, or conducting business operations, and only for the purposes described in this policy.

### 4. Your Choices

You can opt out of SMS messages at any time by texting STOP to (210) 370-3700. You can request updates or deletion of your personal data by contacting contact@masterglasssolutionsusa.com .

### 5. Data Security

We implement reasonable physical, electronic, and managerial safeguards to protect your personal information from unauthorized access or disclosure.

### 6. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated policy will be posted on our website with the effective date.

### 7. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us:
Email: contact@masterglasssolutionsusa.com
Phone: (210) 370-3700

SMS Terms & Conditions Return home

## SMS Terms & Conditions

Source: https://www.mgsusa.llc/terms-and-conditions

LEGAL

### SMS Terms & Conditions
Last updated: August 18, 2026

Program Name: Master Glass Solutions SMS Alerts
Company Legal Name: Master Glass Solutions LLC
Website: https://masterglasssolutionsusa.com
Contact Email: contact@masterglasssolutionsusa.com
Contact Phone: (210) 370-3700
SMS Sending Number: (210) 370-3700

### 1. Program Description

Master Glass Solutions LLC offers SMS alerts to provide customers with service updates, appointment confirmations, quotes, and promotional offers. Message frequency varies based on your interactions and preferences.

### 2. Message Frequency

Message frequency varies. You may receive messages depending on your engagement and subscription preferences.

### 3. Message & Data Rates

Message and data rates may apply to each message sent or received, in accordance with your wireless service plan. Please contact your wireless carrier for details.

### 4. Opt-In

By providing your mobile number and opting in (e.g., via website form, text keyword, or booking confirmation), you consent to receive recurring SMS messages from Master Glass Solutions LLC.

### 5. Opt-Out

You may opt out at any time by texting STOP to (210) 370-3700. After sending STOP, you will receive one final confirmation message stating that you have been unsubscribed. You will not receive further messages unless you opt in again.

### 6. Help

For help, text HELP to (210) 370-3700 or contact us at:
Email: contact@masterglasssolutionsusa.com
Phone: (210) 370-3700

### 7. Privacy Policy

We respect your privacy. Your information will not be sold, rented, or shared with third parties for marketing purposes. We may share data only with service providers who assist in delivering our SMS messages. View our full Privacy Policy here: https://masterglasssolutionsusa.com/privacy-policy

### 8. Supported Carriers

Our messages are supported on most major U.S. wireless carriers, including but not limited to: AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, and others. Delivery is subject to the capabilities of your carrier and your device.

### 9. Changes to Terms

We may revise these SMS Terms & Conditions at any time. Any changes will be effective immediately upon posting on our website.

Example SMS footer for compliance:

“Master Glass Solutions Alerts: Msg & Data rates may apply. Reply STOP to cancel, HELP for help.
T&C: masterglasssolutionsusa.com/terms
Privacy: masterglasssolutionsusa.com/privacy-policy”

### Website Information

Information on this website is provided for general planning purposes and does not create a binding estimate, contract, or service commitment.
